title: Signet cardset and microflow kit for API quickstart (auth, keys, streaming, toolcall)
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Produce a compact, re-usable design asset pack ("Signet" cardset + microflow frames) for the API/SDK quickstart docs that clearly illustrates three converging onboarding themes: 1) authentication & API key lifecycle, 2) streaming response flows (server-sent events / chunked streaming), and 3) tool-calling / function hooks. These assets will be used in the public quickstart, in-console guided tour, and the docs release notes.
deliverables: Signet cardset (12 variants): auth-success, auth-error, key-rotate, key-scope, tokenless-brief, rate-limit, consent-screen, scope-grant, SDK-init, streaming-await, stream-chunk, toolcall-invoke

Microflow frames: 8 horizontal storyboard frames showing the minimal code -> network -> UI sequence for: key creation, rotating keys, initiating streaming, receiving partial tokens, calling a tool/plugin and receiving structured output
Two screenshot-ready mockups: Console 'Create Key' modal and Console 'Live Stream Inspector' with token-level latency and token cost rails
Exported assets: Sketch/Figma file with componentized variants, a small PNG sprite sheet (1200x600), and a set of SVG icons with accessible labels
Documentation pack: short alt-text for each asset, suggested captions for docs, and copy variants for tone (developer-first / enterprise-facing)
acceptance_criteria: All assets are portable (Figma components + exported PNG/SVG) and match brand tokens (RWF-blue #0A57FF, neutral palette, 14px/16px type scale)
Auth flow visuals show explicit steps for key creation, KMS-backed storage hint, and a small callout for rotation best-practices
Streaming mockups demonstrate chunked partial responses and a clear UI affordance for 'resume' and 'cancel'
Tool-calling frame uses a 3-step visual: declare tools -> call with structured arguments -> handle structured response; include an edge-case panel for safety fallback
Design review sign-off from PM and Engineering (comments addressed) and a linked figma file URL
Optimized exports: 2x and 3x PNGs for docs, SVGs with clean ids and no embedded fonts
constraints_and_notes: Keep single-file size < 1.5MB for the sprite sheet. Avoid heavy motion; instead provide 2 frame states for streaming (waiting vs first chunk) to enable lightweight CSS transitions. Do not show real API keys in any screenshot; use masked values 'rw_••••••••'. Use accessibility-conscious color contrast and include alt-text for each asset. Coordinate final copy with docs writer (PM owns tone).
